newsitem.title: FRANCE: Danone says has no plans to sell beer, packaging.
newsitem.headline: Danone says has no plans to sell beer, packaging.

text.p: French food group Danone has no immediate plans to sell its packaging and beer businesses, two important sources of cash flow, chairman Franck Riboud said.

Riboud told French daily Les Echos that Danone was however mulling the future of its pasta and prepared meal business. He said packaging was no longer a strategic asset for Danone but still a profitable business.

"Since it is out of the question to hurt Danone results, it is obvious that it is not in our interest to sell the packaging division, taking into account its profitability and the level of interest rates," he said.
Riboud said beer was both a strategic asset and a source of cash for Danone.
But this position may change if Danone has to finance a large acquisition.
"But to date we do not have plans for a major acquisition," he said,"
Riboud also said Danone was reviewing the future of its pasta and prepared meal business.

"We are looking at our brands portfolio before making a decision. Solutions may not necessarily lead to a sale but may be in linkup or a distribution agreement, for instance in frozen foods on some markets," he said.
